title: Musa's Fantasy Craft
description: A fantasy RPG modpack that runs beautifully on low end devices in 2 GB ram limit.
body:
# Musa's Fantasy Craft

Welcome to a fantasy world that transforms Minecraft to a whole new level! Explore the world to find beautiful landscapes, grand structures, and different types of villages where every single villager has their own name and unique personality! 

---

### ⚔️ A Sneak Peek Into the Fantasy World

* **Overhauled Combat:** Experience fresh new animations for the third-person combat system along with a heckload of new weapons!
* **The Magical Path:** Not a fan of close combat? Don't worry, you can take the magical path of becoming a wizard and burn your enemies—or freeze them—to death.
* **Smart Storage:** Short on inventory space? Not anymore! Now you can craft custom backpacks to carry more. Not only do they have many useful abilities, but they even feature specific slots for your tools and a bed.
* **Dragon Mounts:** Explore the beautiful world to find dragon nests and hatch yourself a dangerous dragon pet to carry you through your journey!
* **Summon Helpers:** Or, find yourself a lonely companion in a dark forest to help you fight your way through the dungeons. There are 10 companions waiting out there for you to find them!

Jump into this immersive world to discover even more mysteries that I haven't mentioned here—need to keep some secrets! Go out there and enjoy a modpack made with love and care. It's a semi-cozy pack, so don't sweat over a dungeon you can't complete right away or miss out on every bit of loot from a structure. There will always be more chances for you. Just enjoy the journey all the way through!

---

### 📱 Optimization & Hardware Requirements

Honestly, the most important thing is that you can play this modpack even on **low-end devices**. All you need to do is allocate a minimum of **2 GB of RAM** and it works fabulously! 

I originally made this modpack just for myself to play, then thought: *why not upload this online too?* It is heavily optimized for **PojavLauncher** as well. I play on a phone myself, and it easily hits a smooth **60 FPS**.

> ⚠️ **Warning for Mobile Users:** You should have at least a mid-to-high-tier phone. I am playing on a Snapdragon 8s Gen 3 and it works just fine for me!

---

### 🎨 Shaders & Video Notes

Please note that I **have not** pre-included Sodium or Iris shaders, as they were causing issues on PojavLauncher for my specific device. 
* If you want to use shaders, you will have to install them yourself.
* I highly recommend playing with performance-friendly, low-end shaders like **MakeUp - Ultra Fast**, but it's completely up to you in the end!

---

### 🎬 For Content Creators

I have fully tested the **Replay Mod** and it works perfectly, so you have no problems there! If you are using this modpack in a video, **giving credit is always highly appreciated**. I will never issue copyright claims or strikes on your videos, so don't worry, but a shout-out to the pack means a lot!

---

### 📌 A Note on Updates

Please keep in mind that this is the **first and final version** of this modpack. I will not be updating it or releasing future versions, as it was built to be a complete, standalone project right from launch. 

In the end, I would like to say a massive thank you to all the amazing mod creators for making such great mods for us to enjoy. 

Thanks for reading all the way to the end, byee~
